shortDescription: Manipulate entries in the key/value store of a Consul cluster

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The CA bundle to use for https connections.

options.name: cas
options.description: Used when acquiring a lock with a session. If the O(cas) is V(0), then Consul only puts the key if it does not already exist. If the O(cas) value is non-zero, then the key is only set if the index matches the ModifyIndex of that key.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: The name of the datacenter to query. If unspecified, the query defaults to the datacenter of the Consul agent on O(host).

options.name: flags
options.description: Opaque positive integer value that can be passed when setting a value.

options.name: key
options.description: The key at which the value should be stored.

options.name: port
options.description: The port on which the consul agent is running.

options.name: recurse
options.description: If the key represents a prefix, each entry with the prefix can be retrieved by setting this to V(true).

options.name: retrieve
options.description: If the O(state) is V(present) and O(value) is set, perform a read after setting the value and return this value.

options.name: scheme
options.description: The protocol scheme on which the Consul agent is running. Defaults to V(http) and can be set to V(https) for secure connections.

options.name: session
options.description: The session that should be used to acquire or release a lock associated with a key/value pair.

options.name: state
options.description: The action to take with the supplied key and value. If the state is V(present) and O(value) is set, the key contents is set to the value supplied and RV(ignore:changed) is set to V(true) only if the value was different to the current contents. If the state is V(present) and O(value) is not set, the existing value associated to the key is returned. The state V(absent) is used to remove the key/value pair, again RV(ignore:changed) is set to V(true) only if the key actually existed prior to the rem

options.name: token
options.description: The token to use for authorization.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate of the Consul agent.

options.name: value
options.description: The value should be associated with the given key, required if O(state) is V(present).
